heads: 3x nn.Linear(32, 1) on the shared L2 embedding (fpts, yards, tds)
loss: mean MSE over 3 z-scored targets (target stats fit on train rows only)
preprocessing: vector_core.RobustScaler (median/IQR, clip [-3,3]) fit on train rows over observed (M==1) cells only; masked cells 0. Targets z-scored on train rows; predictions de-standardized back to raw units.
season_id_clamp: val/test season ids clamped to max train id (3)
